name: Sue Garino

bio.statement: Garino's pamphlet statement lists her occupation as retired public servant and notes an executive board role with the Tigard Police Officers' Association.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Retired Public Servant Occupational Background: Executive Board Member, Tigard Police Officers’ Association; Tigard Police Department

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-36)

bio.statement: The pamphlet lists her prior government experience as Tigard Police Department property and evidence specialist, community service officer and records specialist.
bio.excerpt: Property & Evidence Specialist; Community Service Officer; Records Specialist

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-36)

bio.statement: Her campaign website says she has called Tigard home for more than a decade.
bio.excerpt: Sue Garino has called Tigard home for more than a decade

positions.statement: Garino's pamphlet statement lists limiting growth of taxes, fees and spending, focusing on essential services and requiring measurable results from new spending.
positions.excerpt: Limit the growth of taxes, fees, and spending. Focus taxpayer dollars on essential services. Stop using one-time money for ongoing programs. Require measurable results from new spending.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-36)

positions.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists prioritizing emergency services and responders and maintaining streets, parks, infrastructure and clean water access.
positions.excerpt: Strengthen essential city services. Prioritize emergency services and responders. Maintain streets, parks, and infrastructure. Ensure reliable access to clean water.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-36)

positions.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists streamlining city processes and improving customer service so residents get a prompt answer or follow-up.
positions.excerpt: Make City Hall work for residents. Streamline city processes. Improve customer service.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-36)

positions.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists promoting accessible housing and transportation options for aging residents and protecting the senior center.
positions.excerpt: Advocate for Tigard’s aging residents. Promote accessible housing and transportation options. Protect our senior center.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-36)
